name: AI Chat
description: Ask questions about your notes using an AI agent you already have installed. Answers are grounded in your own writing, with sources you can open.
author: writer

commands.name: chat
commands.title: Chat With Your Notes
commands.subtitle: Ask questions grounded in what you've written

capabilities.name: unsafe
capabilities.reason: Starts the AI assistant you choose (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini) as a separate program on your computer. That program runs with your full account access and Writer cannot restrict what it does.

preferences.name: harness
preferences.title: AI assistant
preferences.description: Which locally installed agent to use. It must already be installed and signed in.

preferences.name: contextNotes
preferences.title: Notes to retrieve per question
preferences.description: More context gives better answers but costs more tokens.
